name: Lard Lost His Lunch
summary: In the Hinterlands, Lard has run to Revantusk and left the picnic lunch behind. A Vilebranch struck Lard at a private picnic, and now Lard asks you to fetch the food from an island to the north.

sections.title: A Picnic Interrupted
sections.body: A Vilebranch struck Lard with a big stick at a secret picnic spot. By Lard's account, the troll was ugly and mean. Lard fled to Revantusk, leaving the lunch behind and fearing a return.

sections.title: The Island Northward
sections.body: Lard's picnic spot lies on an island to the north. Lard hopes you will find the lunch and bring it back. Take care around the Vilebranch trolls.

sections.title: Lard's Thanks
sections.body: Lard's lunch is a huge haunch of meat. Lard wolfs it down, thanks you, and promises a special picnic basket for your help.

faq.answer: Lard lives in Revantusk in the Hinterlands. Hungry and frightened, Lard fled after a Vilebranch struck Lard with a big stick.

faq.q: Where did Lard lose his lunch?
faq.answer: Lard left the lunch at a secret picnic spot on an island to the north.

faq.q: Why did Lard leave his food behind?
faq.answer: A Vilebranch struck Lard with a big stick during the picnic. Lard ran back to Revantusk without the lunch.

faq.q: What should you watch out for on the island?
faq.answer: Lard names the Vilebranch trolls as a danger on the island.

attribution: Classic quest text: Lard Lost His Lunch
